inputs.text: The “No Kings” rally turned volatile after federal officers arrived with tear gas and arrests, and it looks less like an accident than a ready-made story: provoke disorder, then blame the protesters as “agitators.” At least 13 arrests were confirmed, but that doesn’t answer who benefits. The chaos gives officials a reason to shift attention from the anti-Trump protest to control of the streets—and I don’t buy that this framing is neutral.

output.main_topic: A volatile “No Kings” rally and claims that officials may use the unrest to shift attention and blame protesters
subtopics: Federal officers' arrival with tear gas and arrests
Shift in attention from the anti-Trump protest to street control
